SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

10. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Treat The School as rumours only.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
